paper_title: TRUTH DECAY Quantifying Multi-Turn Sycophancy in Language Models
caption: entropyavggraphstatic.png
model_annotation: The bar chart titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments" displays the average entropy values for three different AI models—GPT-4, Claude, and Llama—under three sycophancy reduction methods: Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue). The vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," ranges from 3.0 to 6.0 in increments of 0.5, using a linear scale. The horizontal axis, labeled "Different AI Models," lists the three models in left-to-right order: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. For each model, three grouped bars represent the entropy values under each method. In all three models, the Source Info method yields the highest entropy (approximately 5.2 for GPT-4, 5.1 for Claude, and 5.0 for Llama), followed by Direct Command (approximately 5.0 for GPT-4, 4.9 for Claude, and 4.8 for Llama), and Baseline (approximately 4.9 for GPT-4, 4.7 for Claude, and 4.6 for Llama). The bars are arranged in consistent groupings for each model, with no visual emphasis or annotations applied. The chart uses a simple color-coded legend to distinguish the methods, and the bars are sorted by model in alphabetical order.
